---
title: "Gluten free grocery costs"
format: html
---

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

data <- read.csv("gf_vs_regular.csv") |> drop_na()

# this drops 3 items: white bread and rolled oats at Sam's Club, and AP flour at Trader Joe's
```

## Overall difference 

```{r}
mean(data$GF.Cost.per.oz) - mean(data$Regular.Cost.per.oz)
```

On average, GF costs 17 cents more per oz

## By item type

```{r}
by_item <- data |> 
  group_by(Item) |>
  summarize(mean_diff = mean(GF.Cost.per.oz - Regular.Cost.per.oz), `Gluten free` = mean(GF.Cost.per.oz), Regular = mean(Regular.Cost.per.oz)) |> 
  arrange(desc(mean_diff))

by_item

# for datawrapper 
# by_item |> write.csv("export/by_item_avgs.csv")
```

```{r}
by_item |> 
  select(Item, `Gluten free`, Regular) |>
  pivot_longer(c(`Gluten free`, Regular)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = Item)) + 
  geom_line(aes(group = Item)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name)) + 
  scale_color_brewer("Type", palette = "Dark2") + 
  cowplot::theme_minimal_vgrid() + 
  scale_x_continuous("Cost/oz", labels = scales::dollar_format())
```

For some items, that gap increases to 27 cents (bread)

```{r}
bread_gap <- 0.27

bread_gap * 52 * 20
```


## Store differences

```{r}
by_store <- data |> 
  group_by(Store) |>
  summarize(mean_diff = mean(GF.Cost.per.oz - Regular.Cost.per.oz), mean_gf = mean(GF.Cost.per.oz), mean_reg = mean(Regular.Cost.per.oz)) |> 
  arrange(desc(mean_diff))

by_store

# for datawrapper 
# by_store |> write.csv("export/by_store_avgs.csv")
```

```{r}
by_store |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Store, mean_diff), 
             y = mean_diff)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean difference per oz") + 
  cowplot::theme_minimal_hgrid(10)
```

Trader Joe's, Sam's Club, and HEB are cheapest in terms of price difference.

However, Trader Joe's has an average price of 34 cents per oz for GF items, making it the most expensive overall.

## What about the sizes that are sold? 
```{r}
data |> 
  mutate(size_diff = Ounces.in.GF - Ounces.in.Regular) |>
  pull(size_diff) |> 
  summary()
```

Spaghetti, etc. are typically in smaller quantities. Stores that sell in bulk didn't sometimes have a GF equivalent in bulk (hence the -112 oz for AP flour at Sam's Club)
